messages.text: 看向远方，让眼睛休息一下。
messages.englishText: Look into the distance. Give your eyes a rest.

messages.text: 站起来，伸个懒腰，喝一杯水。
messages.englishText: Stand up, stretch, and have some water.
Relax your shoulders. Take a slow breath.
Step away from the screen. Take a little walk 🌿

messages.text: 致虚极，守静笃。——《道德经》第十六章
messages.englishText: Empty the mind; remain deeply still. — Dao De Jing, 16

messages.text: 上善若水。——《道德经》第八章
messages.englishText: The highest goodness is like water. — Dao De Jing, 8

messages.text: 千里之行，始于足下。——《道德经》第六十四章
messages.englishText: A journey of a thousand miles begins beneath your feet. — Dao De Jing, 64

messages.text: 文武之道，一张一弛。——《礼记·杂记下》
messages.englishText: The way of balance is to alternate tension and relaxation. — Book of Rites

messages.text: 知之者不如好之者，好之者不如乐之者。——《论语·雍也》
messages.englishText: Knowing is less than loving; loving is less than finding joy. — Analects, Yong Ye

messages.text: 人法地，地法天，天法道，道法自然。——《道德经》第二十五章
messages.englishText: Human follows earth, earth follows heaven, heaven follows the Way, and the Way follows nature. — Dao De Jing, 25

messages.text: 三人行，必有我师焉。——《论语·述而》
messages.englishText: Among any three people walking together, there is someone I can learn from. — Analects, Shu Er

messages.text: 逝者如斯夫，不舍昼夜。——《论语·子罕》
messages.englishText: It flows on like this, never ceasing day or night. — Analects, Zi Han
